intro: Converting kilowatts (kW) to horsepower (hp) is essential when translating measurements across electric motor nameplate ratings, automotive dynamometer testing, solar inverter sizing, and generator selection. One kilowatt equals 1.34102 horsepower, while one horsepower equals 0.7457 kilowatts. Whether you are verifying specifications on technical drawings, reconciling international supplier data sheets, or checking everyday measurements, this calculator applies the exact NIST and BIPM conversion factor with instant table lookups and step-by-step worked examples.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Mechanical Imperial Horsepower (745.7 W) vs. Metric Horsepower (PS / CV)
items: This conversion uses standard mechanical/imperial horsepower (1 hp = 550 ft·lbf/s = 745.699872 W), standard across North American automotive and electric motor specifications.
European automotive ratings frequently cite metric horsepower (PS or CV), where 1 PS = 735.49875 W (roughly 1.4% smaller than mechanical hp).

formula.standardNote: Verified against NIST SP 811 and BIPM SI Brochure (1 kW = 1.34102 hp).

faqs.question: How many horsepower are in 1 kilowatt?
faqs.answer: There are 1.34102 horsepower (hp) in 1 kilowatt (kW). To convert kW to hp, use the exact conversion factor 1.34102.

faqs.question: How do I convert kilowatts to horsepower manually?
faqs.answer: Multiply your kilowatt value by 1.34102 (exact factor: 1.34102). For example, 20 kW × 1.34102 = 26.82044 hp.
